meta.title: Balance display
meta.description: Shows the balance and Token Plan usage of every model provider enabled in this DSH profile, under the sidebar, and hides the providers you are not using.

row.peakTip: Peak hours ({windows}) — off-peak is half price

setup.title: Balance display · Setup
setup.subtitle: Keys and cookies are stored in the local DSH credential store — never in the plugin config or the logs.
setup.howToCookie: Sign in to the console → DevTools → Network → any request → copy the whole `Cookie` request header.
setup.howToKey: Create an API key in the console and paste it here.
setup.neverShown: Stored values are never echoed back.
setup.handoff: Opened Settings → Plugins → Balance display — paste it into the form there.
